question: Do the original R17 singular fibres admit a rational block system that could come from a simpler family under rational parameter substitution?
inputs: Only the frozen original R17 coefficients and the existing CAS-free degree-24 irreducibility certificate. No specialized points, ranks, parameters, or new primes.
method: Replay modular irreducibility; extract a 17-cycle from the sixth power of cycle type (1,6,17); exclude all proper block sizes; apply Jordan's prime-cycle theorem and the odd Frobenius. Recompute the j numerator and denominator from original coefficients and their exact rational gcd.
falsifiable_endpoint: A proper imprimitive Galois action leaves rational grouping open. Certified S24 rules out rational nontrivial partitions of the singular divisor and proper rational composition of this j map.
boundary: A family-level structural incidence exclusion, not a specialization rank predictor. This is the constant-field Galois group of singular parameter locations, not the S3 group of the elliptic 2-division cubic and not the monodromy group of j. It does not exclude covers branched over smooth fibres.
